scripts.contracts:test: cargo test --workspace && cd contracts/integration-tests && cargo test
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/orchestrator-api && bun x tsc --noEmit && cd ../studio-web && bun x tsc --noEmit && cd ../../scripts && ../apps/orchestrator-api/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run test:api && bun run contracts:test
scripts.deploy:api:mainnet: cd apps/orchestrator-api && npx -y wrangler@4.86.0 deploy --env mainnet
scripts.build:web:mainnet: cd apps/studio-web && PUBLIC_NETWORK=mainnet PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://yeetpad.fun bun run build
scripts.deploy:web:mainnet: bun run build:web:mainnet && npx -y wrangler@4.86.0 deploy --env mainnet && bun run build:web
